clue.text: Serene massage involves cleansing processes

blocks.note: the letters run from the end of 'serene' into the start of 'massage'

explanation.definitionFit: A euphemistic description: an enema flushes out the bowel, a cleansing process in the most literal medical sense.

clue.text: Bring up former lover, Northern Irish politician

explanation.definitionFit: A literal sense of 'bring up': a buried body is raised out of the earth when it is disinterred.

clue.text: Law bringing back tool of corporal punishment - people taken in by empty threat

explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a law is a statute that has been enacted, and the act of passing it gives the word.

clue.text: Central American once held in Alcatraz, technically

explanation.walkthrough: 'Once' belongs to the definition, not to the prison story: it marks a people of the past.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by history: the Aztecs ruled central Mexico before the Spanish conquest, so they are Central Americans of former times.

clue.text: Method applied by swimmer

clue.text: See 9

clue.text: Problems in birdwatching hut’s sloping surface

clue.text: Art graduate finally got uniform paint finish

explanation.definitionFit: A technical term: a mat (matt) paint dries to an even, non-glossy finish.

clue.text: Sees anger somehow as enthusiasm
